## Summary

Describe the focused change and user scenario. Link a related issue if applicable.

## Validation

List the commands actually run and their results. Separate deterministic fakes,
compilation, prerecorded inference, render-only checks, and authorized device
checks. State what was not exercised; do not infer runtime behavior from a build.

## Safety, privacy, and compatibility

Describe relevant takeover, original-target, cleanup/recovery, settings-schema,
accessibility, and privacy implications. For product model/rendering changes,
identify shared-library harness coverage or document the unexercised boundary.

## Source and licensing

Confirm new files are source-only and redacted, and that you have the right to
contribute them under their applicable license. Preserve third-party notices;
the embedded vocabulary remains CC BY-SA 4.0 rather than MIT.
